evidence_items.evidence_summary: Datasheet explicitly identifies device as WCD9378 and provides CHIP_ID_BYTE_0..3 values (`0x00 0x00 0x10 0x01`) for sample types.
States SoundWire PHY timing is compliant with MIPI SoundWire v1.2.1.

evidence_items.topic: SoundWire identity (numeric mfg/part ID usable for SDW_SLAVE_ENTRY)
evidence_items.evidence_summary: No explicit SoundWire manufacturer ID / SoundWire part ID tuple was found. CHIP_ID bytes in Table 4-3 are not mapped by datasheet text to Linux SDW part-id encoding.
No register offset/base domain tables were found in pages 1-46; document is feature/pin/electrical focused.
No explicit analog register base (such as 0x40180000) is provided in the datasheet.

evidence_items.topic: Class-H / HPH / flyback / CLSH register domains
evidence_items.page_or_section: NOT_FOUND (for register domains); Section 3.6.2 (PDF pages 24-26) for functional Class-H references
evidence_items.evidence_summary: Class-H is referenced as an operating/performance mode for HPH path, but no software-visible Class-H register addresses or domain mapping is provided.
States interrupts go through SoundWire interface. No SDCA register list or SDCA interrupt register map details are provided.

evidence_items.page_or_section: Section 2.2 Table 2-4/2-6 (PDF page 13); Section 3.2 Table 3-2 (PDF page 15)
evidence_items.evidence_summary: Provides reset pin (`RESET_N`) and supply pins/rails (`VDD_CX`, `VDD_PX`, `VDD_A`, `VDD_CP`, `VDD_MIC_BIAS`, `PA_VPOS`, `PA_VNEG`) with operating voltages.

evidence_items.page_or_section: Device description and feature table (PDF pages 1 and 8)
evidence_items.evidence_summary: States four analog Tx ports and four analog Rx ports; SoundWire peripheral info indicates TX and RX SoundWire peripherals with two data lanes each.
No software-visible register map tables/offset definitions were found.
